description: CD34_PRM_Voies_DFCI_34_SARF is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de l'Hérault. Dans le cadre du projet SARF, couche de données simplifiées des Pistes de défense de la forêt contre les incendies (DFCI) opérationnelles de l'Hérault (mai 2026): fusion par numéro de piste Ceci pour fluidifier l'affichage dans une carte sur Hérault Data. Coverage: Département de l'Hérault. The publisher named on the listing is Département de l'Hérault. Its keywords include sarf, dfci, territoires-agriculture-et-innovations. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
